name: gizza-ai/openapi-to-fetch-client
summary: Generate a self-contained typed TypeScript fetch client from an OpenAPI paths spec.

tool.description: Turn an OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0 JSON/YAML document into a dependency-free TypeScript fetch client. It walks paths and operations, emits exported functions or a client class, substitutes path params, serializes query/header params, wires request bodies and response types from local schema refs, and supports throw-style ApiError or result-union error handling. It does not generate model files or fetch remote refs; point types_module at a sibling schema-types file or leave it blank for placeholder aliases.

base_url.description: Base URL baked into the generated client. Blank uses servers[0].url for OpenAPI 3.x or scheme/host/basePath for Swagger 2.0, then an empty string.

client_name.description: Class name when style=class. Ignored for function output. Default ApiClient.

error_handling.description: Non-2xx handling: throw emits an ApiError class and throws; result resolves to an ApiResult<T> union with data or error.

indent.description: Spaces per indentation level in the generated TypeScript (0-8). Default 2.

input_format.description: How to parse spec: auto (try JSON then YAML), json, or yaml. Default auto.

jsdoc.description: Include JSDoc comments from operation summaries/descriptions and parameter descriptions. Default true.

naming.description: Function naming: operation_id uses operationId when present and falls back to method+path; path always derives names from method+path.

param_style.description: Call signature style: object emits one typed request object per operation; positional emits path params, then body, then a query/header object.

spec.description: OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0 document as JSON or YAML. The tool reads the paths object and emits one typed fetch call per operation.

style.description: Output shape: exported functions (default) or one exported client class.

tags.description: Optional comma-separated tag filter. Blank generates every operation; a non-empty filter keeps operations whose tags match.

types_module.description: Module to import local schema types from, e.g. ./types. Blank emits placeholder type aliases so the file stays standalone.
